Game Overview

In Totò, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling arcade quest in Totò, where quick reflexes and sharp timing are your keys to success. Navigate a monster through a vibrant world, dodging obstacles while collecting precious coins. With escalating challenges across three dynamic levels, strategic precision becomes your ultimate ally.
